dedupe_keys.name: national land numerical information railway data kokudo suuchi joho n02 japan

description: The National Land Numerical Information railway data (identifier N02) map every passenger railway and tramway line and station in Japan. Each railway section is a line feature with its railway type (conventional railway, cable car, suspended or straddle monorail and others), operator type (Shinkansen, JR conventional lines, public, private and third-sector railways), line name and operating company; stations are stored as parts of the lines, with station names, unique station codes and group codes that join same-name stations within 300 m. The data are compiled by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism from the Geospatial Information Authority's base maps and tiles, the official railway handbook (Tetsudo Yoran) and operators' websites. Coverage is national, with annual editions from 2005 to 2022; the latest (specification 3.1) is dated 31 December 2022. Files are free to download from the National Land Numerical Information site as JPGIS GML, GeoJSON (from 2016) and shapefiles (about 17 MB for the whole country), under the Public Data License 1.0 of Japan for editions from 2020 and free commercial use for earlier ones, with attribution. Caveats: freight lines, sidings and depot tracks are left out, there are no track counts, speeds or timetables, and the newest edition lags about four years behind. The data support network flow and hazard exposure analysis of Japan's rail network, for example overlaying flood or landslide zones on lines and stations, and pair with GTFS feeds from the Public Transportation Open Data Center.
